source.index_convention: PDF pages 1-based; numbered extracted lines reset at each page; printed page supplied separately.

method: Independent complete PDF text extraction and term scan plus full relevant experimental/numerical/results/conclusion pages; Figures3/4/5,Table3,Figure10/12 and availability visually checked. No author code execution.

experimental_content.acknowledgment_scope: Figures 3b, 4a and 4b are provided by Mohsen Taheri Andani (Texas A&M); Figure 5 uses data provided by Shuai Shao (Auburn). Actual experimental characterization exists, so describing the whole paper as synthetic would be inaccurate.

evidence.item: Nine process settings and EBSD/microCT method

life_data_scope.life_quantity: Physics-derived fatigue crack INITIATION life, not a measured cycles-to-failure campaign.
life_data_scope.simulation_units: A 1.6 mm global cube is subdivided into 64 subcubes, each 0.4 mm wide; five cases. 64 evaluations per case times five cases = 320 evaluations per physical solver. These are not 320 independently manufactured fatigue specimens.

case_labels.1: syntheticgrain/voidstatistical realization informed by recommended setting
case_labels.4: printed characterization parameter set; downstream life still model-derived

life_data_scope.loading: Three physics models use nominal 0.3 percent strain amplitude. PRISMS-Plasticity simulates two cycles under fully reversed cyclic displacement and computes stored work/FIP for the initiation-life formula. This is not an observed run-to-failure.
life_data_scope.fitting: Block extremes of G, surface energy and FIP are fitted from simulation outputs. Figure 7 labels these computed quantities Observed; the label does not denote physically measured Nf.
life_data_scope.correlation: Correlation coefficients 0.8, 0.7, 0.6 are chosen assumptions; they are not calibrated from failed-specimen fatigue testing.

validation_scope.performed: Analytical ratio-distribution PDF compared with direct per-subcube evaluation of the same physics life formula plus KDE; checks distribution-fitting approximation.
validation_scope.not_established: Independent physical fatigue-life coverage, out-of-build empirical calibration, successful stress-level selection, or physicallifeextension.
validation_scope.future_work: Conclusion specifically proposes calibrating correlations using experimental fatigue-life tests of failed prints.
validation_scope.literature_comparison: Introduction discusses prior bending/fatigue experiments by other authors; those summaries are not new observations from this paper. No additional measuredNf test table was identified.

repository_crosscheck.independent_scope: Paper availability says simulation inputfiles. Root separately performed pinned staticrepositoryaudit; this reader did not execute downloaded code.

admission.use: Adjacent physics/microstructure uncertainty prior art and optional numericalbenchmark; cannot fill missing measured specimen-build-lot fatigue campaign.
